dict.string: Maude reads how full your days are, never what is in them. It keeps only numbers: how many entries a day held, how many hours were booked, the longest unbroken run of them, how many hours nothing was booked over, and when the first entry started and the last one ended. Titles, people, places, notes and the names of your calendars are never read, never stored and never sent anywhere.
Maude adds a consultation you plan to your own calendar, with a reminder. This permission lets Maude write that one event and nothing else — it gives Maude no way to read anything in your calendar.
Maude uses your camera only during a video consultation you start with your own clinician or coach, over an EU‑sovereign connection. It is never used otherwise.

Maude uses your microphone only when you start it yourself: recording a voice note for your private journal (kept on this device), or joining a video consultation with your own clinician or coach over an EU‑sovereign connection. It is never used otherwise.
Maude transcribes your voice notes on this device only. Your audio and words never leave your iPhone.
Maude can lock itself to your face, so only you can open your health edition. Face ID runs entirely on this device.
Maude reads your Health data on-device to show your trends and personal, plain-language nudges. Your health data stays on this device and is never uploaded.
Maude is read-only and never writes to Apple Health. It only reads your data on-device to show your trends and personal nudges; nothing is written back.
